business_summary.text: Signpost India is an end-to-end Out-of-Home media platform designing, building, owning, and operating advertising assets across transit media, digital out-of-home, and conventional media, with a focus on long-term contracts.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at double digits with EBITDA margin of 25-27%
FY27 capex guided at ₹60-75 Cr for infrastructure, capacity expansion and technology
48% of FY27 revenue already secured through signed contracts
Digital out-of-home revenue share expected to reach 25% by 2028 from 18% in 2025

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 0.50 Per Share

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Media, Entertainment & Publication > Media > Advertising & Media Agencies

operating_notes.text: Digital out-of-home revenue share increased to 18% in 2025 from 7 billion in 2024, expected to reach 25% by 2028
Transit media revenue grew 22% in 2025 to INR20.2 billion, contributing 30% of total OOH revenue
Bagged 5-year exclusive advertising rights on Chalo premium buses in Mumbai worth approx. ₹36 crore.

timeline.summary: Signpost India received a credit rating upgrade from CRISIL to A-/Stable for its ₹290 Cr bank facilities.
Signpost India held its maiden earnings conference call on June 3, 2026, reporting FY26 results and providing guidance for FY27.
Signpost India won an exclusive 5-year advertising contract worth approx. ₹36 crore for Chalo premium buses in Mumbai.
